title: Aquarius — Something Big Is Coming
script_text: Buckle up, Aquarius—Uranus is about to stir up the skies this week! Mercury sextiles Saturn in the 7th House from Monday through Wednesday, sharpening love talks, while Mars trines Pluto in the 10th House on Tuesday, boosting career confidence; Tuesday’s drive wins promotions, but Wednesday’s Venus square Uranus in the 5th House sparks love turbulence. Thursday brings Jupiter’s entry into the 2nd House, expanding financial opportunities and validating resourceful Air‑element strategies. Friday’s Sun conjunct Mercury in the 1st House sparkles with bold self‑expression, while Saturday’s Neptune opposition to the Ascendant brings dreamy moods; Sunday’s Saturn return to the 4th House grounds you with family duties. Friday is your power day because the Sun‑Mercury conjunction fuels career initiatives. Wednesday is your challenge day as Venus square Uranus ignites love drama. Channel your Air element’s spark into honest partnership talks and invest the new money luck wisely. Follow for daily updates.
